title: Ento-Linguistics: Language, Ambiguity, and Scientific Communication in Entomology
description: Self-contained research project examining how language shapes scientific understanding in entomology through systematic analysis of terminology networks across six Ento-Linguistic domains. Version 1.1.0 adds an inferential statistics stage (Welch pairwise tests with Benjamini-Hochberg correction, Cohen's d, one-way ANOVA), a real per-term semantic-ambiguity computation, the statistical_analysis.json artifact and figure, a thin-orchestrator pipeline, and a token-driven manuscript whose inferential tables resolve from measured data at render time.
